findings: Assigned bundle sha256 9c47b578e2c317b9a7bfc0f0d61856ef18335f5bd026d7f59a2f9eee87e15542 and primary sha256 5fb402bae59b952e4d8b6e5090dbf88689100865dde299c5ddf8a8e2623f35b4 match the assignment row.
CVE-2026-22774 remains PUBLISHED on cveawg.mitre.org; GHSA-vw5p-8cq8-m7mv is reviewed and not withdrawn. The claimed parse DoS is real.

The vulnerable mechanism is typed-array unflatten constructing `new TypedArrayConstructor(hydrate(value[1]))` without verifying an ArrayBuffer, first written in PR #105 member 24f4466144ce36c1c833f28c08321eb8ae0dbb44 and carried to main by squash e46f4c8f4724e673344100790312740a65491d66.
Immediate parent e28031b6e214892620a4e5cb3de8e01ed151126f still base64-decodes value[1] into an ArrayBuffer before construction, so parent-tree absence holds.
Affected membership is the squash on v5.3.0 through v5.6.1; the first patched release is v5.6.2. Direct fix e46afa64dd2b25aa35fb905ba5d20cea63aabbf7 is ancestral to v5.6.2 and not to v5.6.1.
BIC 24f4466144ce36c1c833f28c08321eb8ae0dbb44 is authored and committed by Rich Harris with no AI/generator markers, so the primary NOT_AI verdict stands.
